scope: Verifier diagnostics, not application test failures or baseline artifact drift

initialComparisonIssues.subject: Renderer raw hash
initialComparisonIssues.explanation: Receipt hashes the 20469-byte CRLF checkout. Git HEAD stores 20071-byte LF content. Normalized content and explicit CRLF reproduction match.

initialComparisonIssues.subject: hero-imported and hero-models record arrays
initialComparisonIssues.explanation: All ten records match by ID. Array ordering differs, so comparing serialized arrays without sorting was an invalid verifier assumption.

initialComparisonIssues.subject: Four reconstructed CI log hashes
initialComparisonIssues.explanation: Initial reconstruction omitted internal empty lines and left ESC bytes raw. Retaining empty lines and rendering ESC as ^[ reproduces the prior gh log bytes exactly for all four jobs. Raw archives are retained separately.
